plansModal.title: Choose your plan
plansModal.introTrial: Every plan includes a real {{count}}-day free trial. Free Trial needs no card at all — Starter and Growth ask for one upfront, but you're never charged until the trial is up. You can change plans anytime from Settings.
plansModal.introExpired: Your free trial has ended. Starter and Growth are billed right away once you add a card — Free Trial keeps your workspace running a little longer, but doesn't remove the need to eventually pick a paid plan. You can change plans anytime from Settings.
plansModal.priceLockedBanner: The price you start at is the price you keep, for as long as you stay subscribed.
plansModal.priceLockedFirstCharge_one: Price locked in — first charge in {{count}} day
plansModal.priceLockedFirstCharge_other: Price locked in — first charge in {{count}} days
plansModal.footerTrialActive_one: Your trial ends in {{count}} day. Added a card for Starter or Growth? You're billed automatically then, no extra step. Went with Free Trial instead? Your workspace keeps working for 14 more days before it's paused — plenty of time, no surprise lockout.
plansModal.footerTrialActive_other: Your trial ends in {{count}} days. Added a card for Starter or Growth? You're billed automatically then, no extra step. Went with Free Trial instead? Your workspace keeps working for 14 more days before it's paused — plenty of time, no surprise lockout.
plansModal.footerTrialExpired: Your trial has ended. Add a card for Starter or Growth to be billed right away and keep full access.
plansModal.footerPayrollDisclaimer: * Payroll calculates and tracks pay runs today — it doesn't move money yet. One-click payment processing is coming through a future partnership.

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.description: Sales pipelines for Opportunities. Each pipeline has its own stages — archiving a pipeline keeps its Opportunities visible read-only, it just disappears from creation menus.
pipelines.typeTitle: Pipeline type can't be changed after creation

archiveConfirm.title: Archive "{{name}}"
archiveConfirm.message_one: This pipeline has {{count}} Opportunity. They'll stay visible but become read-only until this pipeline is reactivated, and the pipeline will disappear from creation menus. Type ARCHIVE to confirm.
archiveConfirm.message_other: This pipeline has {{count}} Opportunities. They'll stay visible but become read-only until this pipeline is reactivated, and the pipeline will disappear from creation menus. Type ARCHIVE to confirm.

reactivateConfirm.title: Reactivate "{{name}}"
reactivateConfirm.message: This pipeline will reappear in creation menus and its Opportunities become editable again.

pipelines.stagesHelp: Add the stages a deal moves through in this pipeline. You can leave this empty and add stages later, or reorder/color them once the pipeline is created.
pipelines.outcomeHelp: Open: still active, counts toward the weighted forecast at its probability. Won/Lost: terminal — probability is forced to 100%/0% and can't be edited.

stageEditor.notifyTooltip: Notify the owner (in-app + email) when a deal enters this stage
stageEditor.winProbabilityTooltip: Win probability (%) — used for the weighted pipeline forecast
stageEditor.forcedProbabilityTooltip: Forced — Won is always 100%, Lost is always 0%
